Penn State has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus of any big Pennsylvania university. Drexel is 21 behind.

The big Pennsylvania universities:

1. Penn State: 156
2. Drexel: 135
2. Pitt: 135
4. Penn: 125
5. Temple: 91

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/rankings/pennsylvania/
